title: ECL approval-record extension value v1
description: The value of ecl.ext.approval-record.v1 on an EBMP-2 human intervention event that approves or rejects: what the approver was shown, when, and the minimum review time that applied (ECL1N-0174, ECL1N-0175, EBMP2-063).

presented.description: A digest-bound reference to the presentation the approver saw.
